title: 2025 Verse Year in Review: Our Patients
summary: The DME experience for patients has been slow and confusing for far too long. At Verse, we are redefining the DME experience for every patient, and earned a patient NPS of 73 in 2025.
body_markdown:
## A letter from Dhaivat Pandya,
our Founder & CEO


To the Verse community,


Our vision at Verse is to be the one partner you can rely on when a patient needs hospital-quality care at home. In 2025, we made meaningful progress towards achieving that vision.


We tripled our number of facility partners while retaining 95% of existing facility partners, generated material savings for our health plan partners, and delivered a patient NPS of 73. I'm excited to share additional stats and anecdotes with you in the pages to come.


Thank you for delivering hospital-quality care at home with us in 2025. Here's to an incredible 2026.


Dhaivat Pandya
Founder & CEO


## Our Patient Results


Patient experience in DME must be better.


Incumbent DME network managers and national providers average 1-2 star patient reviews, and Net Promoter Scores (NPS) ranging from -20 to 30. These are clear symptoms of patient dissatisfaction and unmet need.


### We're proud to share that Verse's patients recorded a **73 NPS** in 2025, thanks to our:


## 95%


On-time Delivery Rate


## 99.9%


Order Accuracy Rate


## 98%


Call Resolution Rate


> " *The trust, and freedom of mind, of knowing that my supplier is all over my order and that I will get it within a day or so is golden to me."* **- Verse Medical Patient**


## Thank you.


Here's to better DME for all in 2026.
